about: Read by AFK Realm (https://github.com/aspollon/AFK-Realm) when it builds the server. Without AFK Realm, apply patches/core-subclass.patch to a Conquest of Azeroth core yourself: see README.md.

patches.name: Talent hooks and class mechanics for a second class (CoA Custom subclassing)
patches.why: Subclassing lets the Two-Headed Ogre and the Thin Twins of CoA Custom learn a second class. The module needs hooks the Conquest of Azeroth core does not have yet: extra talent trees and budgets, class mechanics that also run for a borrowed class, and player hooks for quest races, own looks, riding along and borrowed skills. They come from Stefan's handover branch of CoA Custom 2.0, carried onto the current core.
